ExtraDock 4.2.8 – Every Screen, Every Window, Perfectly in Focus! 🖥️🪟

🖥️ Multi-Screen & Display

  • Show on All Screens: A new per-dock toggle mirrors a single dock onto every connected display at once — it appears, repositions, and cleans up automatically as screens come and go, all while staying one managed dock!
  • More Reliable Monitor Identity: Docks now recognize your physical monitors far more accurately, so they reappear on the correct screen even after you unplug, replug, or rearrange displays!
  • Improved Screen Settings UI: A clearer, refreshed interface for assigning docks to specific monitors!

🪟 Dock Click → Window Focus (macOS 14 & 15)

  • Fixed the "Half-Focus" Bug: Clicking a dock icon now properly brings the app's window to the front, not just its menu bar — fixing a long-standing issue on macOS Sonoma and Sequoia!
  • Cross-Space & Multi-Monitor Windows: Clicking an app whose window lives on another Space or display — including Electron/Chromium apps like Claude, Chrome, and VS Code — now reliably raises the real window!
  • Snappier Clicks: Reduced the time between clicking an icon and the window appearing!

🧩 Widgets

  • Space Awareness Context Menu: Right-click a window in the Space Awareness widget to act on it directly!
  • Live Dock — No More Duplicates: Live Dock apps that are also pinned manually are no longer shown twice!
  • Live Dock — Lighter & More Accurate: Lower-overhead refreshing of running apps and their windows, plus a lifecycle fix that keeps the Live Dock in sync as apps launch and quit!
  • Desktop Widget Mode: A new per-dock setting that keeps the dock on the desktop, behind your app windows!

💾 Backup & Restore

  • Automatic Configuration Backups: ExtraDock now automatically saves backups of your dock configuration — a new Automatic Backups section in Settings lets you view, refresh, reveal in Finder, and restore any previous backup, complete with timestamps and item counts!
  • Better Backup Export/Import: Full backup export/import improvements, including fixed export save defaults!

🪄 Onboarding & Permissions

  • Accessibility Permission Reminder: ExtraDock now prompts you to grant Accessibility access, which is required for window focusing and switching to work correctly!
  • Smoother First Run: Onboarding fixes make the first-run setup experience more reliable!

⚡ Performance & Stability

  • Faster Activation: More efficient dock-icon activation and window detection!
  • Smarter Respect Dock Space: Improved handling for newly opened windows!
  • Lower Background CPU: Lower-frequency mouse polling, throttled notification-badge reads, and deduplicated window-tracking registrations all reduce background CPU usage!
  • Auto-Hide Reliability Fix: Prevents a dock from incorrectly hiding when it should stay visible!
  • Larger Custom Spacers: The spacer size limit is now up to 3000!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
